message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the long‑weekend holidays in Canada for 2023 (dates that fall on a weekday will give you an extra day off, creating a three‑day weekend).  
(If you’re in a province with additional holidays, you’ll have more long weekends—just let me know which province and I can add those too!)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend? |
|---------|-------------|-------------|---------------|
| New Year’s Day | Jan 1 (Sunday) | Sunday | **Yes** – New Year’s Eve (Dec 31) is a holiday in some provinces, giving you a four‑day break. |
| Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario) | Feb 20 (Monday) | Monday | **Yes** – A Monday holiday gives you a long weekend. |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 (Friday) | Friday | **Yes** – Good Friday is a statutory holiday in all provinces, giving you a long weekend. |
| Victoria Day | May 22 (Monday) | Monday | **Yes** – A Monday holiday gives you a long weekend. |
| Canada Day | Jul 1 (Saturday) | Saturday | **No** – It falls on a weekend, but many people take the following Monday (Jul 3) as a holiday if it’s a statutory holiday in their province. |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 (Monday) | Monday | **Yes** – A Monday holiday gives you a long weekend. |
| Thanksgiving | Oct 9 (Monday) | Monday | **Yes** – A Monday holiday gives you a long weekend. |
| Remembrance Day | Nov 11 (Wednesday) | Wednesday | **No** – It’s a statutory holiday in most provinces, but it doesn’t create a long weekend unless you take adjacent days off. |
| Christmas Day | Dec 25 (Monday) | Monday | **Yes** – A Monday holiday gives you a long weekend. |
| Boxing Day | Dec 26 (Tuesday) | Tuesday | **No** – It’s a statutory holiday in most provinces, but it doesn’t create a long weekend unless you take adjacent days off. |

### Quick Summary

- **Long weekends** (in most provinces): New Year’s Day (if you take Dec 31), Family Day, Good Friday, Victoria Day, Labour Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas Day.
- **Other holidays** that might give you a break if you take adjacent days off: Canada Day (if you take the following Monday), Remembrance Day, Boxing Day.

Let me know if you’d like the list broken down by province or if you need anything else!
